description: This file declares a namespace with functions for generating random numbers of various types, including inline overloads for signed integers and a template for range-based randomization. It also includes external function declarations for seeding and generating random values, and references a module header.

methods.name: Random(int8_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int8_t by casting to uint8_t and calling the external Random function.

methods.name: Random(int16_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int16_t by casting to uint16_t and calling the external Random function.

methods.name: Random(int32_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int32_t by casting to uint32_t and calling the external Random function.

methods.name: Random(int64_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int64_t by casting to uint64_t and calling the external Random function.

methods.name: Random(DESTTYPE& value, const DESTTYPE minimum, const DESTTYPE maximum)
methods.description: Template function that generates a random value within a specified range by calling the external Random and then adjusting the value to fit within the range.
